errors.evidence: In the figure, the light blue bars represent the statutory minimum wage and the purple bars represent 60% of the median wage; the colors are reversed in the description.

errors.text_span: Der gesetzliche Mindestlohn beträgt 2015 8,50 €, steigt dann auf 10,59 €, 10,82 €, 10,92 €, 9,19 €, 9,35 €, 12,00 €, 12,80 €, 13,12 €, 13,93 €, 14,69 € und schließlich 15,12 € im Jahr 2025.
errors.evidence: The values listed here mix the purple-series numbers into the statutory minimum wage series. The chart shows the minimum wage as 8.50, 8.50, 8.84, 8.84, 9.19, 9.35, 9.55, 10.52, 12.00, 12.41, 12.82, not the sequence given.

errors.text_span: 60 % des Medianlohns von Vollzeitbeschäftigten beginnen bei 8,50 € im Jahr 2015 und steigen auf 12,41 €, 12,82 € im Jahr 2025.
errors.evidence: The purple series is not 8.50 in 2015 and does not only have two values. The chart shows approximately 10.59, 10.82, 10.92, 11.42, 11.80, 12.13, 12.80, 13.12, 13.93, 14.69, 15.12 across 2015-2025.
The description does not mention that the purple bars for 2024 and 2025 are hatched/striped, which is a visible styling feature noted in the reference.
